correctness.rationale: At stationary Poisson age A_N=E/γ_N, E~Exp1, conditional count K_N is Bin(N,p(A_N)) with p(t)=Ω²/(Ω²+Δ²)sin²(sqrt(Ω²+Δ²)t). This yields exact PGF ∫e^{−u}[1−(1−s)p(u/γ_N)]^Ndu. At γ_N=c_NΩ√N, c_N→c>0, Np(u/γ_N)→u²/c², bounded dominated convergence proves mixed-Poisson PGF, factorial moments (2k)!/c^{2k}, mean 2/c² and variance 2/c²+20/c⁴. Exact finite formulas E p=2Ω²/(γ²+4ω²), E p²=24Ω⁴/[(γ²+4ω²)(γ²+16ω²)] and Var(p) were independently symbolically reconciled. For c_N→∞ Markov via E K≤2/c_N² gives zero; c_N→0 with γ_N→∞ conditional mean+variance give c_N²K_N→E² in L² under common age coupling. Independent clocks give Bin(N,μ_N)→Poisson(2/c²). Chernoff mixtures establish −logP(Z_c≥k)/√k→c. Independent high-precision PGF quadrature at c=.8,1.5 and N=512,4096,32768 found error decaying from 2.5×10^{−5} to 4×10^{−7}, corroborating but not replacing the proof.
